listen_addr.description: IP address the IPIP service will bind to for incoming connections.

listen_port.description: TCP port number for the main IPIP control service.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: one of debug, info, warn, error.

log_file.description: Path to the primary log file for IPIP service events.

max_workers.description: Maximum number of worker processes for handling tunnel operations.

enable_auth.description: Enable user authentication for service access.

auth_method.description: Authentication mechanism: currently only 'password' is supported.

users.description: List of named users with permissions to manage IPIP tunnels.

password.description: Password for the user (stored in plain text in config — secure deployments should use external auth).

src_addr.description: Source IP address for the tunnel endpoint.

mtu.description: Maximum Transmission Unit for the tunnel (typically 20 bytes less than Ethernet MTU).

overrides.description: Dictionary of arbitrary key-value overrides for advanced tuning (not recommended unless advised).
